title: Hello & introductions
goal: Introduce yourself and greet someone politely.
介紹自己，並有禮貌地打招呼。

en: Use I am for yourself and you are for the other person. Say my name to introduce yourself.
介紹自己用 I am，說對方用 you are；my name 表示「我的名字」。
zh: Use 我是 + role and 我叫 + name. Put 吗 at the end to make a yes/no question.
用「我是＋身分」和「我叫＋名字」介紹自己。在句末加「嗎」可以提問。

en: Keep the final d in friend. Let your voice fall gently at the end of a statement.
friend 結尾的 d 要清楚。陳述句結尾語調自然下降。
zh: 你好 has two third tones: the first becomes a rising tone in speech. The pinyin keeps the original tones.
「你好」有兩個第三聲，連讀時第一個變成上升的聲調；拼音仍標原調。

practice: Make a name card. Write a greeting and two sentences about yourself; younger learners can draw and say them.
做一張名字卡，寫一句問候和兩句自我介紹；年幼學習者可以畫畫，再說出來。

title: Numbers & age
goal: Count things and say an age or quantity.
數物件，說出年齡和數量。

en: Use one book but two books. Ask How many? for a number of things.
一本用 one book，兩本用 two books。問數量用 How many？
zh: Put a measure word between the number and the noun: 三本书. Use 两 before many measure words, as in 两本书.
數字和名詞之間加量詞，例如「三本書」。量詞前的二常說「兩」，例如「兩本書」。

en: For three, let air pass over your tongue between your teeth. Do not turn it into free or tree.
說 three 時舌尖輕放在上下牙齒之間，讓氣流通過，別說成 free 或 tree。
zh: Keep 四 sì and 十 shí distinct. 四 starts with s; 十 starts with the curled-tongue sh.
分清「四 sì」和「十 shí」；四是平舌 s，十是翹舌 sh。

practice: Count six objects at home. Write their quantities with nouns; younger learners can point and count aloud.
數家中六種物件，把數量和名稱寫下來；年幼學習者可以指着物件數。

title: Family & people
goal: Introduce family members and describe who they are.
介紹家人，說出他們的身分。

en: Use my, your, his and her before a noun. Say This is for one person and These are for more than one.
名詞前用 my、your、his、her 表示所屬；一個人用 This is，多個人用 These are。
zh: Use 的 for possession: 我的家人. With close family, 我的妈妈 and 我妈妈 are both natural.
用「的」表示所屬，例如「我的家人」。親屬稱謂前可以說「我的媽媽」或「我媽媽」。

en: In mother and father, the th is voiced: feel a gentle buzz at your throat.
mother 和 father 的 th 是濁音，喉嚨會輕輕震動。
zh: The second syllable in 妈妈 and 爸爸 is light and short. Do not give both syllables equal stress.
「媽媽、爸爸」的第二個字讀輕聲，要短而輕。

practice: Draw a family or an imaginary family. Label four people and write two introductions.

title: School & learning
goal: Name learning materials and ask for help politely.
說出學習用品，並有禮貌地求助。

en: Use Can I ...? to ask permission and Could you ...? to ask for help. Add please.
用 Can I ...？徵求許可，用 Could you ...？請人幫忙，並加上 please。
zh: Use 请 + action for a polite request. Use 可以吗 to ask permission: 我可以看这本书吗？
用「請＋動作」提出請求，用「可以嗎」徵求許可，例如「我可以看這本書嗎？」。

en: Keep the s and k together at the start of school. Do not add an extra vowel.
school 開頭的 s 和 k 要連在一起，不要加多一個元音。
zh: In 书 shū, curl the tongue slightly for sh. Keep it different from s in 三 sān.
「書 shū」的 sh 要稍微翹舌，與「三 sān」的 s 分清。

practice: Label six learning materials. Write one polite request and act it out with someone.

title: Rooms & belongings
goal: Describe rooms and say where things are.
介紹房間，說出物件的位置。

en: Use in for inside, on for a surface and under for below: The bag is under the table.
in 表示在裏面，on 表示在表面，under 表示在下面，例如 The bag is under the table。
zh: Put the place after 在: 书在桌子上. Add 上、下、里 after the place word.
「在」後面接地點，例如「書在桌子上」；地點後面可加「上、下、裏」。

en: Finish room with your lips together for m. Finish in with your tongue for n.
room 的 m 結尾要合唇，in 的 n 結尾要用舌尖。
zh: Distinguish n and l in 哪里. Move the tongue for each syllable rather than blending them.
說「哪裏」時留意 n 和 l，每個音節都要清楚。

practice: Draw a room. Write where three objects are; younger learners can point and say on, under or in.

title: Time & daily routines
goal: Describe a day and ask when something happens.
介紹一天的生活，詢問活動時間。

en: Use the present simple for routines: I eat, she eats. Use at for a time and every for a repeated day.
日常習慣用一般現在式：I eat、she eats；時間前用 at，重複的日子可用 every。
zh: Time usually comes before the action: 我早上吃饭. 今天 and 每天 can also start the sentence.
時間通常放在動作前，例如「我早上吃飯」；「今天、每天」也可以放在句首。

en: Keep the final consonants in breakfast. Say the stressed syllable clearly without adding extra vowels.
breakfast 結尾的輔音要清楚，重讀音節要突出，不要加多餘的元音。
zh: 早 zǎo begins with z, not zh. 晚 wǎn ends in n, not ng.
「早 zǎo」是平舌 z；「晚 wǎn」以 n 結尾，不是 ng。

title: Animals & abilities
goal: Describe animals and say what they can do.
介紹動物，說出牠們的本領。

en: Use can + the action: A bird can fly. Can does not change with he, she or it.
can 後接動詞原形，例如 A bird can fly；主語是 he、she 或 it 時，can 也不變。
zh: Use 会 + action for a learned skill, and 能 for ability or possibility. Birds fly: 鸟会飞.
「會＋動作」可以表示本領；「能」表示能力或可能性，例如「鳥會飛」。

title: Around town
goal: Name places and give simple directions.

en: Use Where is ...? to ask about a place. Directions use the action directly: Turn left. Go straight.

en: Keep the r in right different from the l in left. The tongue does not touch the roof for r.

zh: 区 qū uses rounded lips for ü even though the dots are not written after q.

goal: Describe what you want and ask about price.

en: Put a colour before the noun: a red shirt. Use this for one nearby item and these for several.

zh: Use 多少钱 to ask the price. Colours often take 的 before a noun: 红色的衣服.
問價錢用「多少錢」；顏色修飾名詞時常加「的」，例如「紅色的衣服」。

en: The vowel in blue is long and rounded. Keep the final z sound in shoes.
blue 的元音要圓唇並拉長；shoes 結尾的 z 要清楚。
zh: 绿 lǜ uses ü, not u. Keep the lips rounded while the tongue stays forward.

title: Weather & seasons
goal: Describe the weather and choose suitable activities.
形容天氣，選擇合適的活動。

en: Use It is + weather word: It is sunny. Use because to give a reason and if for a condition.
用 It is＋天氣形容詞，例如 It is sunny；because 表示原因，if 表示條件。
zh: Weather descriptions often use 很: 今天很冷. Use 下雨 for rain and 因为 for a reason.
形容天氣常用「很」，例如「今天很冷」；下雨用「下雨」，原因用「因為」。

en: In weather, the th is voiced. Keep it distinct from the unvoiced th in three.
weather 的 th 是濁音，要與 three 的清音 th 分清。
zh: 雨 yǔ uses the ü vowel. 冷 lěng ends in ng, with the back of the tongue raised.
「雨 yǔ」的韻母是 ü；「冷 lěng」的 ng 結尾要抬起舌根。

title: Hobbies & invitations
goal: Talk about interests and invite someone to join you.

en: After enjoy, use the -ing form: I enjoy swimming. Invite someone with Would you like to ...?

goal: Describe how you feel and ask for support clearly.

en: Use I feel + an adjective: I feel tired. Use need + a noun or need to + a verb.
I feel 後加形容詞，例如 I feel tired；need 後加名詞，need to 後加動詞。

en: Begin happy with a gentle breath for h. Keep the last sound in sad different from sat.
happy 的 h 要輕輕呼氣；sad 結尾的音要與 sat 分清。

title: Transport & journeys
goal: Choose transport, ask for a ticket and explain a journey.

en: Use by + transport: by bus, by train. Use take the bus when the vehicle is the object of the action.
by 後接交通工具，例如 by bus；以車輛作動詞受詞時可說 take the bus。
zh: Use 坐 for travelling by a vehicle: 坐火车. 从 introduces the starting point; 到 introduces the destination.
乘搭交通工具用「坐」，例如「坐火車」；起點用「從」，終點用「到」。

en: Start train with t and r together. Keep the s at the end of bus clear.
train 開頭的 t、r 要連在一起；bus 結尾的 s 要清楚。
zh: 车 chē and 去 qù have different initials and vowels. Practise each slowly.
「車 chē」和「去 qù」的聲母、韻母都不同，先慢慢練習。

title: Yesterday & stories
goal: Tell a short past event in a clear order.
按清楚的順序說一件過去的事。

en: Past events use past forms: go becomes went, play becomes played. Use first, then and finally to order events.
過去的事用過去式，例如 go 變 went、play 變 played；用 first、then、finally 表示次序。
zh: Time words such as 昨天 locate an event in the past. 了 often marks a completed action; it is not a past-tense ending for every verb.
「昨天」等時間詞表示過去；「了」常表示動作完成，並不是每個過去動詞都要加。

en: The ending of played is d, while the ending of walked is t. Do not add a whole extra syllable.
played 結尾讀 d，walked 結尾讀 t；不要多加一個音節。
zh: The 了 in 看了 is usually short and light: le. Do not stretch it into a full stressed tone.
「看了」的「了」通常讀短而輕的 le，不要讀成重讀音節。

title: Plans & opinions
goal: Make a plan, give a reason and respond to another opinion.
訂計劃，說明原因，回應別人的意見。

en: Use going to for a plan and because for a reason. Respond politely with I agree or I see your point, but ...
計劃可用 going to，原因用 because；有禮貌地回應可用 I agree 或 I see your point, but ...。
zh: Use 打算 + action for a plan, 因为…所以… for cause and result, and 我觉得 to introduce an opinion.
用「打算＋動作」表達計劃，「因為……所以……」表達因果，「我覺得」引出意見。

en: Stress the key information in a plan: tomorrow, meet, park. Keep small connecting words lighter.
說計劃時重讀 tomorrow、meet、park 等關鍵詞，連接詞可以輕讀。
zh: Keep sentence rhythm in short meaning groups. Do not pause between every Chinese character.
按意思分成短語來說，不要每個字都停頓。
